props.name: children
props.description: Anything with focusable elements in it — cards, tiles, a toolbar of odd shapes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. When set, the container is a labelled group.

props.name: homeEnd
props.description: Home and End jump to the first and last focusable element.

props.name: coneAngle
props.description: Half-angle of the search cone, in degrees. Narrower keeps a move in its lane; wider reaches diagonal neighbours when nothing is straight ahead.

props.name: ignore
props.description: Extra selector for elements that keep the arrow keys for themselves.
